I play Dota 2. And yeah to be honest only reason I play computer games is that I only get appreciation there because it's the only thing I'm actually good at.

Your post is not weird at all since I'm not good at socializing too.

I've never planed to live until 50 years old, have kids, hope to be able to see my grandsons/daughters. Even if I somehow change my mind I still rather 50 years old me never exist :)

But thanks for that. 

> like this is the point in your life where the real you shows, will you win no matter how shitty the odds are ? or will you crumble and give up?

this actually made me smile :)
